# Module `lune_ui_core::widgets::banner`

[API reference](../../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core::widgets`](../widgets.md)

A banner and an empty state that take the caller's own text (`widget.banner-empty-state`).

[`Ui::banner`](../ui.md#method.Ui.banner) is a warning strip: a solid dark fill, a 1 px light border, a spinning glyph and
a wrapped line, all in the warning light colour. [`Ui::empty_state`](../ui.md#method.Ui.empty_state) is a centred column: a
100 by 100 picture the app registered, a title, a centred subtitle and a row of secondary
buttons. Texts and commands are the app's (D128); the toolkit bundles no picture.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/widgets/banner.rs:1`
